verdict.rationale: BILL documents a first-party v3 REST API that covers Spend & Expense (budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements), so the product can be driven programmatically without its UI. It also offers a sandbox for testing workflows without moving real money and webhooks for event-driven automation. There is no documented CLI, no CI-oriented tooling or guidance, and the sandbox description centres on AP rather than S&E. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation, S&E-specific sandbox coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
